title: SoftBank's Son explored $1tr bid for SK hynix, but deal no longer under active review
html:
Proposed price would exceed SK hynix's market cap by about 570 trillion won

SoftBank says deal not currently being pursued

SoftBank Group Chairman Son Masayoshi explored financing options with Wall Street institutions for a roughly $1 trillion acquisition of SK hynix, according to a media report. SoftBank, however, said the deal is no longer under active consideration.

Reuters reported Friday (local time), citing The Information, that Son had recently approached Wall Street financial institutions to inquire about the feasibility of financing a takeover of SK hynix.

The acquisition price Son was considering stood at approximately $1 trillion. SK hynix currently has a market capitalization of about 777 trillion won ($584 billion), meaning the proposed price would exceed that figure by roughly 570 trillion won.

A SoftBank Group spokesperson told The Information, however, that "SoftBank reviews a variety of opportunities, and this transaction is no longer under active consideration."

Reuters said it contacted SoftBank Group and SK hynix for comment but did not receive an immediate response.
